sloka: विज्ञातं ते मया दूत वाक्यं यस्य प्रभाषसे ।नैतत्त्वमसि नैवासौ भ्रात्रा येनासि चोदितः ।। ७.१३.३५ ॥
transliteration: vijñātaṁ te mayā dūta vākyaṁ yasya prabhāṣase ।naitattvamasi naivāsau bhrātrā yenāsi coditaḥ ।। 7.13.35 ॥

translations.english: O messenger, I have understood your words which you speak and whose message it is; you are not this person, nor is he the brother by whom you claim to be instigated.
